name: quota-watch
description: The CEO's 93% quota rule: polls every 5 minutes for the whole session and wakes the lead at the threshold, the hold's release, the reset and a reading that stays unknown

name: stall-watch
description: Wakes the lead the moment teammate work stalls or a teammate escalates: a resource wait over 10 minutes, a live teammate with no commit and no transcript activity for 20 minutes, a teammate waiting on a slot its own process holds, or a new teammate escalation (again every 10 minutes while one needs the CEO at a device). Looks every 60 s, tells each once, and only reports

name: codex-watch
description: Wakes the lead when Codex writes to it: each new entry in ~/.richos-coordination/rich-codex/to-rich.md or rich-codex-questions/to-rich.md is told once, with every one of its lines. Looks every 15 s and only reads
